B10_acceptance_evidence: Original five-system imported cohort (10 trajectories) uses the existing five-system acceptance; remaining50 trajectories use original per-worker ledgers, all reread and hashed.

execution_source_applicability.all30_frozen_made_all30_runner.py: The50 new all30 B10 extension jobs. It is not asserted to have executed the original two/five-system jobs.
execution_source_applicability.original_core_and_five_system_jobs: Their original scope fingerprints and raw result hashes remain authoritative; later inclusion does not relabel their executing source.
execution_source_applicability.sweep_frozen_made_budget_runner.py: New B30/B50 sweep jobs only. It is not asserted to have executed any B10 historical job.

metric_definition: SUN is the final current official discovery count, including decreases as the hull changes; mSUN=SUN/B; AUDC=2*trapezoidal_integral(SUN)/B^2. No cumulative maximum is applied.
path_policy: Paths are relative to the source experiment project and do not promise raw files in this repository. Raw/source artifact SHA256 values differ from exported-file SHA256 values.
result_hash_field_semantics: Legacy raw_result_sha256/raw_result_relative_path identify the actual source result envelope. For Ga-Pt-Tm baseline B50 this is the explicitly labelled independently derived envelope, not an original runner result. No original result or success receipt is invented.
seed_variance: Only evaluation seed1 is available. Run-to-run variance/SD are unavailable. The statistics.csv sample variance(ddof1) is secondary cross-system dispersion, not repeat-seed uncertainty.
source_inventory_scope: Result/receipt/ledger identities and existing registered fixed profiles checked; no repeated whole-model or ancestor-asset deep audit.
